campaign.title: Complete coupled adjacent-dyadic alpha difference

resource_policy.literature_policy: No external theorem is needed for the exact scale algebra. Search only if the resulting signed scale sum exactly matches a named theorem.

frozen_target.question: Does the complete coupled difference between adjacent physical dyadic scales admit a target-relevant signed partial-sum bound, or what exact profile/height/Mellin survivor blocks it?
frozen_target.reference_formula: D_j=2^(-j)floor(sqrt X), H_j=floor(D_j X^(-1/4)), W(t)=eta(t)-eta(2t), A_j(u,v)=W_hat_j(u) phi_hat(v)(D_j/(2sqrt X))^u(H_j+1)^v, and physical profile B_j(n,q)=V_j^*(2sqrt(Xn/q)/D_j) phi(n/(H_j+1)).
quantities: top, bottom, support, profile-star and product-star owners
signed scale partial sums and boundary terms

completion_criteria: Both finite-Mellin and physical-return differences are written on common supports.
Every scale, height, profile, support, star, radial and normalization change is owned once.
The W telescoping identity is applied with exact top and bottom boundary owners.
Any Abel transformation in j includes an explicit actual signed partial-sum hypothesis and boundary terms.
A target-relevant saving is proved or a sharp actual-profile capacity obstruction is derived.
Finite-height and physical-limit conclusions are kept distinct.
A clean statement-only derivation and independent hostile audit exist.
No full alpha or downstream promotion follows from scale algebra alone.

tasks.target: Construct the exact finite and physical adjacent-dyadic differences with a complete owner table, then prove a signed scale-partial-sum saving or isolate the first exact survivor/countercapacity.
Using only the Round-53 packet, independently construct the lawful coupled scale difference, audit exact telescoping and decide what bound follows without an unstated partial-sum theorem.
Hostile-audit common-support ownership, W telescoping, height/profile mismatch, finite-v bulk capacity, boundary terms and any unproved signed partial-sum claim for the complete scale family.

review_seams.requirement: Write adjacent-scale Mellin factors on one common finite antecedent.
Write returned profiles on common support with all stars and boundaries.
Audit top, bottom, height, and profile boundary residues in every scale telescoping claim.
Require an actual signed scale-partial-sum estimate before claiming a saving.
The blind proof sees only the Round-53 packet and its brief.
